title: Korean Zesty Chicken Wings Bowl
description: A delicious and spicy Korean-style dish featuring crispy fried chicken wings tossed in a zesty sauce, served in a light and flavorful bowl.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger.
3. Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat.
4. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray.
5. Arrange the chicken wings on the baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes.
6. While the chicken is baking, heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
7. Add the Korean chili flakes and cook for 1 minute.
8. Add the light soy sauce and rice vinegar to the skillet and stir to combine.
9. Remove the chicken from the oven and toss in the skillet to coat with the zesty sauce.
10. Return the chicken to the baking sheet and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
11. Garnish with chopped green onions and serve in a light and flavorful bowl.
